svg.title: Where each part is documented
svg.desc: The robotaxi with leader lines to six folders of assurance/ and what each holds: 04-hardware: Hardware safety requirements, design, metrics, evaluation of bought-in elements; 02-concept: Item definition, ODD, HARA, FSC, fallback and minimal risk concept, SOTIF hazards and insufficiencies, TARA, AI safety requirements; 06-validation: Safety validation, SOTIF scenario evaluation, fault injection, penetration testing, test operations, simulation credibility; 09-production-operation: Production, fleet operation, user information, field monitoring, incident response, safety performance indicators; 05-software: Software requirements, architecture, units, verification, ML engineering, calibration and HD map data; 03-system: Technical safety requirements and concept, system architecture, timing, HSI, system integration and verification. Also in assurance/: 00-assessment, 01-management, 07-supporting, 08-analyses, 10-safety-case, case, trace.
